source: Decoded ARM64 scalar/SIMD numerical data flow, translated into pure Rust expressions and explicit basic blocks. No original instructions, target mapping, dynamic compiler, or emulator is present at playback.
runtime: Rust-owned 0x8000-byte state; fixed scratch, input, and call-stack buffers allocated during construction. Native 32-frame control clock.
observed_validation: 16 original-ARM64 initialization snapshots match bit-for-bit; 6144 stereo frames match bit-for-bit including all-eight-control/boost changes; final circuit state tolerance checked. Deterministic reset/stereo/mono tests pass.
limitations: Isolated numerical equivalence does not establish full Kontakt-host lifecycle parity.
Base constructor replaced with initially zero base state, base volume anticipation reproduced, base SmoothVolumeAndOut remains owned by adapter routing.
Architecture-exact reciprocal estimate uses portable ARM intrinsics on aarch64; portable integer estimate on other hosts is not covered by this ARM64 fixture run.
